mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS personaId, v.version, COALESCE(v.artifact_hash, s.artifact_hash) AS artifactHash, v.compiler_version AS compilerVersion, CAST(v.canonical_spec_json AS CHAR) AS canonicalSpec, v.runtime_prompt AS runtimePrompt, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.persona_kind AS personaKind FROM ai_agent_persona ap JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = ap.persona_source_id JOIN ai_persona_version v ON v.persona_source_id = s.id WHERE ap.agent_id = #{agentId} AND ap.enabled = 1 AND ap.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND s.archived = 0 AND v.status = 'published' AND ( (#{version} IS NOT NULL AND #{version} != '' AND v.version = #{version}) OR ((#{version} IS NULL OR #{version} = '') AND ap.published_version IS NOT NULL AND ap.published_version != '' AND v.version = ap.published_version) OR ((#{version} IS NULL OR #{version} = '') AND (ap.published_version IS NULL OR ap.published_version = '') AND (s.latest_published_version IS NULL OR s.latest_published_version = '' OR v.version = s.latest_published_version)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.version = s.latest_published_version THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, v.published_at DESC, v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_persona_source s JOIN ai_persona_version v ON v.persona_source_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{personaId} AND s.archived = 0 AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) AND v.status = 'published' AND (#{version} IS NULL OR #{version} = '' OR v.version = #{version})

SELECT s.id AS personaId, s.display_name AS displayName, s.description, s.avatar_path AS avatarPath, s.persona_kind AS personaKind, s.latest_published_version AS publishedVersion, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.visibility FROM ai_persona_source s WHERE s.archived = 0 AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_persona_version v WHERE v.persona_source_id = s.id AND v.status = 'published' ) ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.display_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_import_job( id, owner_user_id, source_type, source_url, source_ref, artifact_path, status, progress, created_at, updated_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ownerUserId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceRef}, #{artifactPath}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) )

SELECT id, status FROM ai_persona_import_job WHERE status IN ('queued', 'resolving_source', 'downloading', 'inspecting', 'compiling', 'validating') AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_persona_import_job SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued', 'resolving_source', 'downloading', 'inspecting', 'compiling', 'validating') AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, source_type AS sourceType, source_url AS sourceUrl, source_ref AS sourceRef, resolved_commit AS resolvedCommit, artifact_hash AS artifactHash, artifact_path AS artifactPath, status, progress, CAST(inspection_json AS CHAR) AS inspectionJson, CAST(compile_result_json AS CHAR) AS compileResultJson, error_code AS errorCode, error_message_safe AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_persona_import_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}

SELECT id, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, source_type AS sourceType, source_url AS sourceUrl, source_ref AS sourceRef, resolved_commit AS resolvedCommit, artifact_hash AS artifactHash, artifact_path AS artifactPath, status, progress, CAST(inspection_json AS CHAR) AS inspectionJson, CAST(compile_result_json AS CHAR) AS compileResultJson FROM ai_persona_import_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_persona_import_job SET status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), progress = COALESCE(#{progress}, progress), resolved_commit = COALESCE(#{resolvedCommit}, resolved_commit), artifact_hash = COALESCE(#{artifactHash}, artifact_hash), artifact_path = COALESCE(#{artifactPath}, artifact_path), inspection_json = COALESCE(#{inspectionJson}, inspection_json), compile_result_json = COALESCE(#{compileResultJson}, compile_result_json), error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message_safe = #{errorMessageSafe}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'cancelled'
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM ai_persona_import_job WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_source( id, owner_user_id, visibility, adapter_type, display_name, persona_kind, description, source_url, source_ref, source_commit, artifact_hash, upstream_schema_version, raw_artifact_path, is_real_person, is_public_figure, relationship_ceiling, archived, creator, created_at, updater, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{personaId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{visibility}, #{adapterType}, #{displayName}, #{personaKind}, #{description}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceRef}, #{sourceCommit}, #{artifactHash}, #{upstreamSchemaVersion}, #{artifactPath}, #{realPerson}, #{publicFigure}, #{relationshipCeiling}, 0, #{ownerUserId}, NOW(), #{ownerUserId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), persona_kind = VALUES(persona_kind), description = VALUES(description), source_url = VALUES(source_url), source_ref = VALUES(source_ref), source_commit = VALUES(source_commit), artifact_hash = VALUES(artifact_hash), upstream_schema_version = VALUES(upstream_schema_version), raw_artifact_path = VALUES(raw_artifact_path), is_real_person = VALUES(is_real_person), is_public_figure = VALUES(is_public_figure), relationship_ceiling = VALUES(relationship_ceiling), archived = 0, updater = VALUES(updater), updated_at = NOW()

SELECT s.id AS personaId, s.display_name AS displayName, s.description, s.avatar_path AS avatarPath, s.persona_kind AS personaKind, s.visibility, s.source_url AS sourceUrl, s.source_commit AS sourceCommit, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.latest_published_version AS publishedVersion, (s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AS owned, s.archived, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_persona_source s WHERE s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public') ORDER BY s.archived ASC, s.updated_at DESC

SELECT s.id AS personaId, s.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, s.display_name AS displayName, s.description, s.avatar_path AS avatarPath, s.persona_kind AS personaKind, s.visibility, s.source_url AS sourceUrl, s.source_ref AS sourceRef, s.source_commit AS sourceCommit, s.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, s.is_real_person AS realPerson, s.is_public_figure AS publicFigure, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.latest_published_version AS publishedVersion, (s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AS owned, s.archived, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_persona_source s WHERE s.id = #{personaId} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) LIMIT 1

SELECT v.version, v.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, v.source_commit AS sourceCommit, v.compiler_version AS compilerVersion, v.token_count AS tokenCount, v.quality_score AS qualityScore, v.test_status AS testStatus, v.status, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_at AS publishedAt, v.archived_at AS archivedAt FROM ai_persona_version v JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = v.persona_source_id WHERE v.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.version, v.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, v.source_commit AS sourceCommit, v.compiler_version AS compilerVersion, v.token_count AS tokenCount, v.quality_score AS qualityScore, v.test_status AS testStatus, CAST(v.test_report AS CHAR) AS testReport, v.status, CAST(v.validation_report AS CHAR) AS validationReport, CAST(v.canonical_spec_json AS CHAR) AS canonicalSpec, v.runtime_prompt AS runtimePrompt, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_at AS publishedAt, v.archived_at AS archivedAt FROM ai_persona_version v JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = v.persona_source_id WHERE v.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND v.version = #{version} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_test_run( id, persona_source_id, version, suite_version, model_config_id, status, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{personaId}, #{version}, #{suiteVersion}, #{modelConfigId}, 'pending', #{createdBy}, NOW() )
